speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Sit. The peas are boiled to nothing, the bread is a sop in warm ale, and the apple is baked. That is the supper.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The peas have no body left in them. They are a grey water with a memory of a pea.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: They were peas at noon. They have been persuaded.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The sop is bread that has given up. I can feel the ale, and I cannot feel the crust.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: The crust was the part that would have argued with your jaw. I took it off.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: And the apple is split, and it steams, and it is soft as a compliment. I am tired of being spared.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: The food has already yielded more than you have.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: That is a hard saying over a soft supper.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: The loaf at noon was a penny, and a full thumb short of the notch. I kept the soft of it for this.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: A penny still, and less bread than the notch was cut for.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Threepence is your board, as it has been. The firing is sixpence with the washing, and the hall candle is that sixpence. What you burn upstairs is your own.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am not burning three. I am burning the one in the hall, and I am complaining, which costs you nothing.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: I have a riddle. What a barber-surgeon charges for a tooth, and what he charges for the rest of the head.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Stop there. You will not have the answer at my table.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: I had not come to the answer. I only had the asking.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: De rest kost meer.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Master Verbeke.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: I will not translate. The lady has stopped the riddle. I only finished the sound of it.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: And that is the end of it. Eat what was set down.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Laughing is not the thing that hurts.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then the apple has done more than the peas. Eat it, and leave the riddle where I put it.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: A bad thread you pull out, and you do not sew it back. That is all I know of a bad thread.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then we will not sew it. I had rather talk of the apple than of a thread.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Evening prayer is already said. We said it at this table before the peas came up. You are not going out again to say it in the dark.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I was not going. I have been in since I came from church, and my mouth was shut there.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: You came in with it still shut. Gib took the warm end of the bench, and I left him.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Leave him the bench. A man may sit an hour in church and owe the hour nothing but his seat.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: You will be in your bed by eight. No man walks a chamber at midnight for pleasure, and this week has had enough of walking one.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Eight, then. If the jaw wakes me, it wakes me. I will not go looking for a reason to be up.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: The cat has the corner of the board. I will not move a cat for a spoon.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Leave him. The apple can spare a corner.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: The apple can spare nothing if you mean to eat it. His tail is across the bowl.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: I can shift the bowl. I will not shift Gib. He knows when a hand is coming, and he stays the more.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then let the bowl stay, and let me have the half of the apple that is clear of him.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Mark me. Soft food tonight, and no heroics on the stair. A caller can wait until a man can chew.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: There is no caller tonight. There is this jaw, and a bed at eight. That is the whole of the bill.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then pay the bill by going up when the apple is done. Threepence buys the board. It does not buy a second supper of talk.
